title: TodayWeather for Android: native app user manual
scenario: Version 2.0.0 preview, Korean screens. English instructions retain Korean control labels. Live examples captured on 13 November 2026; weather, ads and Android dialogs may vary.

steps.title: Read the first-launch notice
steps.instruction: Open TodayWeather and read 선택 접근 권한 (Optional permissions). Tap 확인 (OK). The notice retains legacy storage/phone wording; this native app asks Android for location and notifications when needed.
steps.caption: The access notice appears over the start page.
steps.expected: The notice closes; the start page remains.

steps.title: Choose how to start
steps.instruction: Tap 현재위치 날씨보기 (Weather at my location), choose a city shortcut, or enter a place in the search field. Internet access is needed for current weather.
steps.caption: The start page offers location, city shortcuts and search.
steps.expected: A selected place opens its weather. Search also works without location permission.

steps.title: Allow location when needed
steps.instruction: After choosing current-location weather, use the Android permission dialog. Choose 앱 사용 중에만 허용 (While using the app). Approximate location is also supported; it may select a nearby area.
steps.caption: Android asks for location access.
steps.expected: The app finds the position and loads its weather. If denied, use place search; a permanently denied permission can be changed in Android Settings.

steps.title: Recognize your current location
steps.instruction: Check the place name and location pin in the header. Use the hourly, daily and air tabs at the bottom. The example uses an emulator position near Seoul City Hall.
steps.caption: Current-location weather after a successful position lookup.
steps.expected: The header identifies the area found from the location. Values and place names depend on your position and the latest data.

steps.title: Read hourly weather
steps.instruction: Tap 시간별날씨 (Hourly weather). Read the current temperature and summary, then the hourly sky, precipitation probability and temperature chart. Swipe up to see lower cards.
steps.caption: Hourly weather for a saved Seoul location.
steps.expected: The blue chart shows forecast temperatures; the gray comparison shows yesterday where available.

steps.title: Expand chart details
steps.instruction: Tap the downward chevron below the hourly chart. Tap it again to collapse the additional detail rows.
steps.caption: The expanded hourly chart includes wind and humidity information.
steps.expected: The extra rows appear below the temperature plot.

steps.title: Look at earlier hours
steps.instruction: Swipe right across the chart to move toward the earliest available hours. Read the date above the time labels.
steps.caption: The chart at its earliest available position.
steps.expected: Earlier hours become visible; the scroll stops at the available data boundary.

steps.title: Look at later hours
steps.instruction: Swipe left across the chart to move toward the latest available hours.
steps.caption: The chart at its latest available position.
steps.expected: Later forecast hours appear. The available range depends on the weather source.

steps.title: Read daily weather
steps.instruction: Tap 일별날씨 (Daily weather). Read the dates, sky symbols, precipitation and low/high temperature ranges. Swipe up for detail cards.
steps.caption: The daily tab at its initial date position.
steps.expected: Daily forecast information replaces the hourly chart.

steps.title: Look at earlier days
steps.instruction: Swipe right across the daily chart to view the earliest available dates.
steps.caption: Earlier days in the daily chart.
steps.expected: Past dates appear where the source supplies them.

steps.title: Look at later days
steps.instruction: Swipe left across the daily chart to view the latest available dates.
steps.caption: The latest dates available in this capture.
steps.expected: Later daily forecasts appear; do not treat the example dates as a fixed forecast window.

steps.title: Read the air-quality summary
steps.instruction: Tap 대기정보 (Air information). Read the grade and advice, then swipe up to see pollutant cards and the information source.
steps.caption: The air-quality tab for Seoul.
steps.expected: The selected air standard controls the grade bands. Missing readings may appear as a dash.

steps.title: Choose a pollutant
steps.instruction: Tap 초미세먼지 (PM2.5) in a pollutant card.
steps.caption: PM2.5 concentration and its grade are selected.
steps.expected: The main reading and chart change to the selected pollutant.

steps.title: Find nearby monitoring stations
steps.instruction: Swipe up to 측정소 (Monitoring stations). Compare the available station cards and timestamps.
steps.caption: Station choices and source information below the air charts.
steps.expected: The currently selected station is marked; station availability depends on the source.

steps.title: Change the monitoring station
steps.instruction: Tap another station card.
steps.caption: The main air reading after selecting the second station.
steps.expected: The selected card, main value and station information update together.

steps.title: Open saved places
steps.instruction: Tap 즐겨찾기 (Favorites). The current-location entry is separate from saved places. Use the search field to add another place.
steps.caption: The places list with Seoul saved.
steps.expected: The list shows the available locations and their alarm buttons.

steps.title: Search for a place
steps.instruction: Enter 부산 (Busan). Review the result name and address before choosing it. If the keyboard is open, the first tap may only dismiss it; tap the result again to select.
steps.caption: Search results for Busan.
steps.expected: Choosing a result adds the place and opens its weather. Duplicate places are not added again.

steps.title: Check the newly added place
steps.instruction: Confirm the new place name in the weather header.
steps.caption: Weather after selecting Busan from search.
steps.expected: The saved-place list gains Busan and weather loads for its coordinates.

steps.title: Switch between saved places
steps.instruction: Use the left/right arrows beside the weather summary, or swipe the header, to move between enabled places.
steps.caption: Seoul selected again after moving from Busan.
steps.expected: The header and weather change to the selected saved place.

steps.title: Add an overseas place
steps.instruction: Return to 즐겨찾기 (Favorites), enter London, and select the matching search prediction. Check its country/address before choosing.
steps.caption: Weather for the selected London result.
steps.expected: The app loads overseas weather. Forecast sources and available details can differ from Korea.

steps.title: Edit the places list
steps.instruction: Open 즐겨찾기 (Favorites) and tap the edit control. Tap the delete control beside the place you no longer need.
steps.caption: Delete controls in the places list.
steps.expected: Deleting removes that saved place; the current-location entry is managed separately.

steps.title: Verify a deletion
steps.instruction: Check that the deleted place is absent. Leave edit mode when finished.
steps.caption: The list after deleting London.
steps.expected: The remaining places stay saved. You can search for a deleted place again later.

steps.title: Allow notifications
steps.instruction: Open the bell for a location. On Android 13 or later, tap 허용 (Allow) if you want weather notifications. You can change this in Android Settings later.
steps.caption: Android notification permission for the native app.
steps.expected: The permission dialog closes. Permission alone does not save an alarm or guarantee delivery.

steps.title: Review location-specific alarms
steps.instruction: Use the bell in the weather header or beside a saved place. Review the enabled days, weather conditions and scheduled times. Swipe up for lower controls.
steps.caption: Alarm settings for the selected location.
steps.expected: Edits apply to this location when saved. The manual capture does not register or deliver a real notification.

steps.title: Edit a scheduled time
steps.instruction: Tap a time row. Use the arrow controls and AM/PM selector, then 설정 (Set) to apply or 닫기 (Close) to cancel. Check the resulting time before saving.
steps.caption: The native time picker.
steps.expected: The row reflects the chosen time. Known inherited behavior: 12:00 AM deletes a row, noon may open as AM, and 12:30 PM may become 00:30. Avoid these noon values until corrected.

steps.title: Leave edited alarm settings
steps.instruction: After editing, use 취소 (Cancel) or the page back arrow. The app asks 저장하시겠습니까? (Save changes?). Choose 닫기 (Close) to discard or 저장 (Save) to apply. The capture chooses Close.
steps.caption: Save-changes question when leaving an edited alarm page.
steps.expected: Close discards the edits. Save applies them and attempts registration when supported. The main 저장 (Save) button saves directly; Android Back leaves without this question.

steps.title: Open the menu
steps.instruction: Tap the three-line menu button. Swipe up in the menu to reach lower settings and information items.
steps.caption: The native app menu.
steps.expected: The menu provides nationwide information, units, startup, refresh, theme and privacy controls. Some nationwide items appear only for the Korean region.

steps.title: Choose measurement units
steps.instruction: Open 단위설정 (Units). Tap the measurement you want to change.
steps.caption: Unit settings including temperature, wind, pressure, distance, precipitation and air standard.
steps.expected: A choice list opens for the selected measurement.

steps.title: Choose a temperature unit
steps.instruction: Tap the temperature row, then choose C or F.
steps.caption: The temperature-unit choices.
steps.expected: The selected row gains a check mark and the unit is saved.

steps.title: Check the saved unit
steps.instruction: Check that F is selected. Use the back arrow to return to Units and then to the weather.
steps.caption: Fahrenheit selected in the temperature list.
steps.expected: Weather temperatures use the saved unit when the data is applied. Change back to C in the same way.

steps.title: Choose the startup tab
steps.instruction: Open 시작 페이지 (Startup page) from the menu. Select the tab you want to see when the app starts.
steps.caption: Startup-page choices.
steps.expected: A check mark identifies the saved choice. This does not replace the first-launch setup when no place has been configured.

steps.title: Choose the refresh interval
steps.instruction: Open 업데이트 주기 (Refresh interval). Select 수동 (Manual) or an interval. You can also tap the selected weather tab to request a refresh.
steps.caption: Refresh-interval choices.
steps.expected: The app saves the choice. A refresh needs network access and current data from the provider.

steps.title: Choose a theme
steps.instruction: Open 테마 설정 (Theme) and select 어두운 테마 (Dark theme).
steps.caption: Dark theme selected in the choice list.
steps.expected: The page colors change and the choice is saved.

steps.title: Read weather in dark theme
steps.instruction: Return to the weather tab after selecting the dark theme.
steps.caption: The hourly page in dark theme.
steps.expected: The same weather information appears with the selected theme colors.

steps.title: Use the photo theme
steps.instruction: Choose 날씨 사진 테마 (Photo theme) and return to weather. Allow the photo feed and image to load.
steps.caption: Photo theme on the weather header.
steps.expected: A photo appears when available. If the feed or image cannot load, the app may show its fallback background.

steps.title: Read weather warnings
steps.instruction: From the menu, open 기상특보 (Weather warnings). Swipe to read any available bulletins.
steps.caption: The current warnings page at capture time.
steps.expected: The page shows bulletins supplied by the source, or an empty state when none are available. Check the announcement time.

steps.title: View nationwide weather
steps.instruction: Open 전국날씨 (Nationwide weather). Read the city labels and values.
steps.caption: The nationwide weather map.
steps.expected: Weather values appear for the listed Korean cities when supplied by the source.

steps.title: Change the nationwide map mode
steps.instruction: Use the mode controls on 전국날씨 (Nationwide weather) to view wind.
steps.caption: Nationwide wind mode.
steps.expected: The map labels change to wind direction and speed.

steps.title: View nationwide air quality
steps.instruction: Open 전국미세먼지 (Nationwide air). Choose a pollutant in the tab strip; swipe the strip if an option is off-screen.
steps.caption: The nationwide air-quality map.
steps.expected: Regional values and colors change with the selected pollutant and available readings.

steps.title: Read app information
steps.instruction: Open 정보 (About) from the menu. Read the version and application information, then close the dialog.
steps.caption: The About dialog over the menu.
steps.expected: The menu remains when the dialog closes.

steps.title: Choose optional usage statistics
steps.instruction: Open 선택적 이용 통계 (Optional usage statistics). Read the explanation and choose whether to allow collection. This manual keeps collection off.
steps.caption: The optional analytics choice.
steps.expected: Your choice is saved. Withdrawing consent disables collection. A choice made in the old app is not automatically treated as native consent.

steps.title: Review advertising privacy options
steps.instruction: Open 광고 개인정보 선택 (Ad privacy choices). The available form depends on the advertising consent service and region.
steps.caption: The ad-privacy response in this capture environment.
steps.expected: A form opens when required; otherwise an explanatory message appears. This is separate from optional usage statistics.

steps.title: Share weather using Android
steps.instruction: Tap the share icon in the weather header. Review the Android chooser and choose an app only if you want to send the weather text. Back cancels.
steps.caption: The Android share chooser; no recipient is selected.
steps.expected: Android hands a text weather summary and app link to the chosen app. This manual stops before sending anything.

steps.title: Close the app
steps.instruction: From the main screen, press Android Back. Read the exit confirmation. Cancel to keep using the app or confirm to close it.
steps.caption: Exit confirmation on the native app.
steps.expected: Cancel keeps the app open. Back first closes an open dialog or page before reaching the exit prompt.
